findings.detail: Rows flagged by PP03 are comparative-period SOI positions retained in the 2025-12-31 holdings set; representative older rows differ from the current-period rows for the same issuers.

rationale: PP03 is localized to the listed row-validation records rather than an aggregate anchor. Raw source has current SOI rows for the same issuers, but also older comparative SOI rows: for example Acquia's current source row has 9.59% interest and 11/1/2026 maturity, while the cited comparative row has 11.73% interest and 10/31/2025 maturity; ASG II likewise appears in a current row at 10.24% and in a comparative row at 10.99%. Retaining those earlier-period rows under report_date 2025-12-31 is a real comparative-period leak, not a false alarm.
